theme_central: Two paths, two facilitations: for whoever gives and fears Allah, the path of ease is made easy; for whoever is stingy and self-sufficient, the path of hardship.
sources_note: Content widely taught and undisputed: classical 5-movement structure around the two opposing paths.

branches.title: Oaths, divergent efforts
branches.resume: Oath by the night and the day, the creation of male and female; your efforts are diverse.

children.t: Oaths by the night and the day, diverse human efforts

branches.title: The path of ease
branches.resume: Whoever gives and fears Allah, and testifies to the best reward: the path of ease is made easy.

children.t: Generosity and fear of Allah, the path of ease made easy

branches.title: The path of hardship
branches.resume: Whoever is stingy and self-sufficient, and denies the best reward: the path of hardship made easy.

children.t: Stinginess and denial, path of hardship; wealth will be of no use

branches.title: Guidance, warning
branches.resume: Guidance belongs to Allah, as do the hereafter and this life; warning of a Fire for the most wretched.

children.t: Guidance belonging to Allah, Fire reserved for the most wretched

branches.title: The most pious
branches.resume: Kept away from the Fire is whoever gives to purify himself, expecting nothing in return but the Face of his Lord.

children.t: The most pious gives expecting nothing, seeking Allah's Face alone
